value: Curtis Yarvin, also known as Mencius Moldbug, is a far-right political blogger and software developer recognized as a founder of the anti-egalitarian and anti-democratic Dark Enlightenment (neo-reactionary) movement. He advocates for replacing American democracy with an "accountable monarchy" modeled on corporate governance, arguing that a "Cathedral" of elite institutions controls public discourse. Despite his controversial views, including those on race and historical institutions, Yarvin's ideas—along with his Urbit software platform—have gained considerable ideological influence within the American Right, notably among figures like Peter Thiel and JD Vance.
